$comment: Sine mods checked with Zen Fluent. tested: the Zen Fluent version and the mod version of the last check; the settings page shows Works only while both still match (Zen Fluent by major.minor). status: supported, partial (works with a limit), conflict (some parts look wrong; the page asks before installing it) or breaks (a whole theme that replaces Zen's look: left out of the page's marketplace).

mods.name: Advanced Tab Groups
mods.summary: Firefox's tab groups: their headers take the row of a Zen folder, with the folder icon tinted in the group's color.

mods.name: ZenLibraryTweaks
mods.summary: More Library sections and reorderable tabs: its History rows, reordering and edit mode follow Zen Fluent's Library.

mods.name: Glance Plus
mods.summary: Glance rules and two more Glance buttons, drawn as Zen Fluent's round Acrylic buttons with Fluent icons.

mods.name: Zen Second Sidebar Enhanced
mods.summary: Web panels in a second sidebar: the page card's radius and shadow, WinUI hovers, Acrylic over the page.

mods.name: Zen Command Palette
mods.summary: Commands in the URL bar: its accents and its Commands pill follow Zen Fluent's accent.

mods.name: Zen Calmer Context Menu
mods.summary: Folds and reorders context menu entries: its quick actions and icons line up with Zen Fluent's menu rows.

mods.name: Zen Easel
mods.summary: An infinite canvas at about:easel, whose panels take Zen Fluent's accent, Acrylic, strokes and font.

mods.name: BetterZenGradientPicker
mods.summary: Its gradients tint the window over the backdrop, as in Zen; its colors reach the accent through Zen workspace color.

mods.name: Zen Page Tint
mods.summary: Colors the window from the page, which is what Zen Fluent's material does: its layered rules win over Zen Fluent's.

mods.name: Blended Addressbar
mods.summary: Recolors the URL bar and frames the page its own way, over Zen Fluent's URL bar and page card.

mods.name: Better Find Bar
mods.summary: A floating find bar where Zen Fluent draws a strip along the page: the two mix into neither.

mods.name: SuperPins
mods.summary: Its Essentials grid and workspace indicator replace Zen Fluent's own.

mods.name: Nebula
mods.summary: A whole theme for Zen: its sidebar, tabs, URL bar and page frame replace Zen Fluent's own, and the two together break the window.

mods.name: Arc 2.0
mods.summary: An Arc-like theme for the whole window: its sidebar, tabs and URL bar replace Zen Fluent's own, and the two together break the window.

mods.name: Zia
mods.summary: Rebuilds Zen with its own page card, site-colored toolbar and sidebar, over every part Zen Fluent styles: the two together break the window.

mods.name: Neo Zen
mods.summary: A whole theme for Zen that restyles the same window as Zen Fluent: the two together break it.

mods.name: Livs Theme
mods.summary: A new look for the whole of Zen (sidebar, Essentials, tabs, URL bar): it replaces Zen Fluent's, and the two together break the window.

mods.name: macaron
mods.summary: A neobrutalist theme for the whole window: its borders and colors replace Zen Fluent's, and the two together break it.

mods.name: Wireframe 2.0
mods.summary: A minimal squared theme for the whole window: it replaces Zen Fluent's look, and the two together break it.
